place.summary: Ngong Ping 360 functions primarily as a connector in Hong Kong's visitor network. Its strongest observed source market is PH. It receives notable inbound connections from Lantau Island. Visitors often continue to Lantau Island. Its observed experience trails the category average, despite existing visitor demand.

opportunity_cards.title: Frequent companion: Lantau Island
opportunity_cards.detail: Ngong Ping 360 frequently appears alongside Lantau Island, suggesting cross-promotion or route packaging potential.

opportunity_cards.title: High visibility, weaker experience
opportunity_cards.detail: Ngong Ping 360 draws meaningful traffic but performs below its category average on experience.
